sources.name: T.C. Sağlık Bakanlığı Açık Veri
sources.notes: License applies only to datasets explicitly published under the platform license, not general ministry news, images or third-party material. Review each dataset and attribution requirements before use; not a news feed.

sources.name: Anadolu Ajansı
sources.notes: Excluded from free-source assumptions. Reassess only after a subscription contract and cost are explicitly approved.

sources.name: Press Haber Ajansı (PHA)
sources.notes: Published terms permit free website/app republication with attribution. Live RSS endpoint and item structure passed the technical smoke test. Automatic import is limited to recent, non-sensitive lifestyle stories; GUID is used only for deduplication, never as an article URL.

sources.name: Basin Bültenleri
sources.notes: Publisher page states publishers may use official company bulletins free of charge, republish them as-is with source attribution, and use press images shared in bulletins. Feed field coverage passed a 14-item dry-run. Automatic import remains limited to recent, non-sensitive lifestyle stories; attribution and original article links are retained where provided.
